title: SLI, SLO and error budget built on top of CloudWatch

videos.script: Is the shop reliable enough? Without a number, that question is an argument. {{argument}} An objective turns it into arithmetic. Ninety-nine point nine percent of requests succeed, over thirty days. What is left over, one in a thousand, is the error budget. Forty-three minutes a month, for a full outage. {{budget}} While budget remains, the team ships. When it runs out, reliability work comes first. Nobody has to win a debate. {{policy}} Then the alert that follows from it. Not on how bad this minute is, but on how fast the budget is burning. {{burn}} This lesson computes the burn rate over two windows from the shop's metrics, and finds the case where one window would have paged twenty minutes after the incident was over. {{windows}} By the end, you can write an objective for a service, and an alert that wakes somebody only when the month is really in danger. {{end}}
